## Advisor angle
Clients may ask whether to worry about a falling AI-heavy market. An advisor can explain that one company's earnings miss and a swing in oil move headlines, but that long-term plans rest on diversification and goals, not one day's futures. The Fed's rate hold with hawkish dissents also gives a reason to review how much rate risk clients hold in bonds.

## Term of the day: Dissent
At a Fed meeting, a member votes against the majority decision. Here, two officials wanted a hike while the committee held rates. Dissents can hint at where policy may head next.

## Interview talking point
"Last week's Fed hold came with two dissents in favor of a hike, which tells me the committee is debating inflation, not just waiting."
